description: Finding from fz-9zq.1 research: R1 treats an arrow as a leaf, so closure towers (f01130, sc8_100, t3) still need fold_self_nested_closures (types/mod.rs). Proposal: give the clash rule an Arrow(fn_id) head whose slots are the captures, so one rule covers closure towers and fold_self_nested_closures is deleted. Unprobed. Paper first: predictions on f01130/sc8_100/t3 and ordinary closure code, then probe.
title: A closure tower folds by the clash rule
